scientific_goal: Unify TN inference with the accepted hydrologic-model training philosophy while replacing the implicit centuries-long mineral carryover with an explicit, externally constrained agricultural-N legacy structure.

model_unification_principle.forbidden_interpretation: The current canonical hydrology does not contain a station residual intercept. Station flow history is compressed into BFI signatures and regionalized through static attributes before being embedded in conserved fast/percolation states.

authoritative_hydrology.model_family: conserved DYN2P with BFI-signature static-attribute regionalization embedded in fast-versus-percolation state recursion
authoritative_hydrology.channel_geometry_role: Andreadis width/depth and topology reach length may be used only with canonical simulated flow to calculate channel hydraulic exposure.

tn_hydrology_interface.semantic_boundary: The monthly hydraulic fractions are diagnostics/sufficient frozen drivers, not a candidate-independent upper-layer TN operator. Every fitted alpha/beta candidate still requires daily N-mobilization compilation from frozen daily hydrology.

tn_output_layers.gauged_conditional: The same population prediction plus a training-history site effect in the observation head only.
